construction: A 1930s-40s cast Catalin (marbled phenolic) radio knob: a skirt tier, a 12-flute rosette whose flutes roll from a near-vertical grip wall onto a 50° shoulder and end in round arches, a bead step, and a low dome with a raised centre boss. The pointer is an engraved, paint-filled line along the +X lobe crest from the dome centre to the skirt, in a contrasting resin colour. The body is translucent random-walk subsurface resin: colour runs from deep (thick) through base to glow (thin rims and fins), driven by an inside-AO path-length proxy, with a folded domain-warped 3D marbling field, a softer second layer sampled below the skin, sparse crazing hairlines and slight surface yellowing. The whole object, marbling included, rotates through 270° under a fixed studio and dead-on 85 mm camera.
